spans.s:
(ऋ) मेथृ r. 1st cl. (मेथति-ते)
1 To understand, to comprehend.
2 To hurt, to injure.
3 To associate.

m. (-थिः)
The part of a threshing floor, round which the cattle turn to tread out the corn.
f. (-थी)
A sort of grass, (Trigonella foenugræcum.)
E.
मथ to understand, &c. इन् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added in the fem. form मेथिका.
